# Siteviral

> Africa-first digital platform to sell digital products, collect donations via Mobile Money & cards, book service providers, and earn by sharing as an ambassador.

Siteviral is a multi-vertical marketplace and creator platform for Africa and the diaspora. Creators, churches, tutors, beauty pros, home artisans, and event vendors publish public pages, accept payments in FCFA/EUR/USD (Orange Money, MTN, Wave, cards), and grow through a built-in ambassador program.
